info.title: Tool Logger REST API
info.description: Native observation and durable source ingestion. Tokens are separate read/admin and source-scoped write credentials. Requests are bounded to 9 MiB, accommodating 8 MiB native journal records plus envelope overhead. Acknowledgements follow durable commit. Source/event IDs deduplicate retries; conflicting contents return 409. Native payloads remain complete JSON objects.
